description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki Japanese OEM King Pins for the Knuckle/Axle
These will fit the top and bottom of both sides (LH & RH)
Made in Japan – Highest Quality
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – King Pins (Driver’s Side)
Qty 2 – King Pins (Passenger’s Side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
